capability: Isolate a nested package from the workspace that contains its directory.
observed_failure:
error: current package believes it's in a workspace when it's not:
current:   /work/.../Cargo.toml
workspace: /work/Cargo.toml

prompt_intro: This crate does not build. It sits below a workspace directory but declares no workspace of its own, so Cargo believes it belongs to the outer workspace and is not a member. Make it its own workspace. Keep the behaviour.
